description: This file provides a utility function 'apiGet' for making HTTP GET requests with automatic URL resolution, organization ID injection, and logging. It handles different URL types (absolute, relative, with /api), constructs headers with authentication, and processes JSON or text responses.

methods.name: isAbsoluteUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL is absolute (starts with http:// or https://).

methods.name: getBaseApiUrl
methods.description: Determines the base API URL based on window location, environment variable, or defaults to '/api'.

methods.name: joinUrl
methods.description: Joins a base URL and a path, handling absolute URLs and /api paths correctly.

methods.name: ensureOrgIdInUrl
methods.description: Appends organization_id or tenant_id to the URL if not already present.
